analysis:
Examined all supplied source, patches and file metadata against the canonical definition index and selected T-041 detail. No independently supported security regression is established in this scope.
ClusterSetupWizardStore.swift:99–114 adds an optional persisted fallback timestamp; existing bounded, private-mode storage remains visible at 191–215. Integration must examine the timestamp's writers and retry consumers: cooldown expiration must not replace current coordinator authorization or revive revoked approvals (T-053).
ClusterPublicModels.swift:45–104 introduces two artifact-bound public-model declarations, pipeline/tensor families, schedules, rank facts and broad request envelopes. Nil artifact identity intentionally permits declared-family lookup; whether a verified artifact is required before public admission is not shown. DistributedInstalledPairServingGrant.swift's changed ownerServing/publicTrafficLine paths union these declarations into status reporting, while retaining qualification records and adding their canonical digest (head patch:185–205, 475–476, 650–673, 800–828). The visible changes do not establish a coordinator authorization bypass; status text still defers placement decisions to coordinator parity qualification.
Next pass must trace ClusterRuntimeApprovalFacts generation and admission consumers, validate the referenced evidence report against emitted artifact/rank/mode/schedule/request-envelope qualifications, and confirm speculative-assistant exclusion is enforced beyond display text. Relevant contracts are A-017, T-007, T-027, T-052, T-054 and T-056: release declarations or evidence hashes must not substitute for independent qualification or current serving permission. Verify actual model limits and resource admission bound the million-token allowances, and public media/cache paths preserve T-050/T-041 protections. Those implementations are outside the supplied evidence, not observed missing controls. The threat model may need qualification/public-cluster scope updates if these declarations change its approval provenance contract.
